newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to list Innovex options on Jan 2.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to list Innovex options on Jan 2.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said it would list options on shares of Innovex Inc on January 2.

The exchange said the options would open with strike prices of 25, 30 and 35, with initial expirations in January, February, May and August. G-Bar Ltd will be the specialist unit. Shares of the electrical component maker closed Thursday at 29-1/8, up two.
The Chicago Board Options Exchange and the American Stock Exchange also plan to list Innovex options. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
